purpose: Phase 2/3 rapid full-pool canonical reconciliation to size true remaining learner-card backlog without native-by-county gating. Source names never deleted or silently conflated.

classification_policy.INSTALLED_EXACT_CANONICAL: Exact canon scientific name from 552-row manifest-backed Species Tracker
classification_policy.INSTALLED_ORIGINAL_SOURCE: Exact tracker Source Pool Name of a manifest-installed card; botanical rank/concept may need follow-up
classification_policy.VERIFIED_EXISTING_ALIAS: Previously individually checked alias or source concept to current installed card; preserve original
classification_policy.POSSIBLE_ACCEPTED_NAME_TO_INSTALLED: Master note appears to point at installed accepted name; identity or synonym not yet independently reconciled
classification_policy.INFRASPECIFIC_PARENT_REVIEW: Infraspecific source record has installed species-level parent; no automatic merge
classification_policy.IDENTITY_CONCEPT_HOLD: Name identity conflict requires explicit decision
classification_policy.ACCEPTED_NONCANONICAL_CANDIDATE: Accepted/reviewed taxonomy hints; no canonical target located; candidate NOT install-ready until accepted taxon and duplication checked
classification_policy.REQUIRES_TAXON_IDENTITY_TRIAGE: No safe installed mapping or conclusive accepted-name evidence; do not label new species yet
